2. Query 2 covers the roles of skip connections, zero ops, and pooling in the cell. It looks for work on how skip_connect, none, and avg_pool_3x3 change gradient flow, path connectivity, and accuracy depending on which other edges are present or removed.
3. Query 3 covers how cell topology constrains performance. It looks for studies of how the paths from input to output in a DAG cell, together with conv-versus-parameter-free op composition, determine accuracy across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet16-120.
